issues.quote: I walk in the cold when I want to think, and I smoke Brissago, the cheap ones.
issues.fact: B2 says only that Girard went out to smoke at 10:21 by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house. The sheet gives no walking or movement away from the house.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this as Girard admitting he habitually walks off while smoking, so he may have left the spot under the windows during the 10:21 to 10:46 interval, which would widen his whereabouts and make the 10:29 piano and 10:34 bells less reliable as a check on his position.
